name: George Latimer

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIVE AMERICAN MONTH
statements.title: NATIVE AMERICAN MONTH
sentences: We will not let the contributions of Native Americans in our country be erased. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING FOR ENERGY PRICE RELIEF
statements.title: CALLING FOR ENERGY PRICE RELIEF
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as we approach the winter months and the weather gets colder, millions of Americans will see the cost of heating their homes rise amidst the President's war in Iran.

Instead of delivering real price relief for the American people, President Trump's war in Iran, his tariffs, and his reckless cuts to social safety net programs are decimating family budgets as we descend into the winter season.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CAPITOL THEATRE CELEBRATES 100 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
statements.title: CAPITOL THEATRE CELEBRATES 100 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
sentences: In Congress, serving on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, I will continue working to strengthen the bond between our two nations and to honor our strong NATO alliances. ``Happy Independence Day''; ``Gezuar Diten e Pavaresise.'' That is the best I can do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING ATTENTION TO LONG-TERM FINANCIAL OUTLOOK OF SOCIAL SECURITY
statements.title: CALLING ATTENTION TO LONG-TERM FINANCIAL OUTLOOK OF SOCIAL SECURITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to call attention to the long- term financial outlook of Social Security.
According to the Social Security Administration, the Social Security trust fund will be able to pay full benefits only until the end of 2032.
Social Security is a lifeline that lifts seniors, widows, and dependent children out of poverty.
Inaction will only perpetuate an inevitable spike in poverty if Congress fails to act to ensure Social Security's long-term solvency.
I implore my colleagues to come together in this moral moment to save Social Security before we subject our constituents to a reduction in their hard-earned benefits. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING PUBLIC TRUST
statements.title: RESTORING PUBLIC TRUST
sentences: This is because people are being ripped away from their loved ones at traffic stops and medical visits by State and local law enforcement officials who have been enlisted to operate as assistants to ICE's campaign, all while eroding the trust that community members should have in their local law enforcement.

To top it off, ICE is carrying out these raids using taxpayer dollars that could otherwise go to quelling the affordability crisis, strengthening American jobs, and aiding our economy during the President's costly war with Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to rein in this out-of-control agency and work to restore public trust in local law enforcement agencies. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE HUDSON INDEPENDENT
statements.title: THE HUDSON INDEPENDENT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I want to salute the tremendous community contribution of The Hudson Independent, an online publication that chronicles the lives and stories of people, organizations, governments, schools, businesses, and the like, in the municipalities that border the Hudson River in Westchester County in New York: Ardsley, Dobbs Ferry, Irvington, Hastings-on-Hudson, Tarrytown, and Sleepy Hollow.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HIGH COST OF WAR
statements.title: HIGH COST OF WAR
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today more than 5 months since the American people were forced into a war of choice in Iran.

With this money, we could have instead paid for: 66 million Social Security retirement checks, 2 years of free school lunch for every child in the United States, 2 million teachers' salaries, 1 million 4- year college degrees, or the entire SNAP program for a year, serving 40 million Americans in need of food assistance.

Need I remind the American people that he has already demolished the White House Rose Garden, planned to take over a 100-year-old public golf course in Washington, D.C., and plastered two large posters of his likeness on government buildings along The National Mall, just to name a few, and also placing his name on our coinage and currency.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXERCISING CONSTITUTIONAL SCRUTINY
statements.title: EXERCISING CONSTITUTIONAL SCRUTINY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week we were horrified to learn of the death of four U.S. servicemembers in Jordan and Kuwait as a result of the ongoing war with Iran.
Someone must answer to the American people why soldiers serving at support bases neither in Iran nor the at the Strait of Hormuz are being exposed to enemy fire.
The President and the Pentagon may dismiss these deaths as unfortunate consequences of war; however, I do not accept these catastrophic events as acceptable in any way, shape, or form.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
statements.title: AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
sentences: This is a real crisis, and it is made worse by the President's decisions: a war of choice in Iran, indiscriminate tariffs, and tax cuts for billionaires, just to name a few, all this while 1 month of groceries in my home district in New York now averages over $1,200 a month.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING UKRAINE
statements.title: SUPPORTING UKRAINE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy established July 15 as Statehood Day for Ukraine, but we spend another year on this day wondering when the Ukrainian people will be able to celebrate without threats from Russia.

The length of the war in Ukraine has recently surpassed World War I, and it is an outrage that Ukraine has been forced to incur staggering casualties and defend its territory against a relentless dictator.
That is why I firmly reassert the need to continue funding Ukraine's defense.
From the floor of the House of Representatives, I extend my regards to our Ukrainian friends and allies.
Addressing Affordable Housing Crisis Mr. Speaker, in New York and across the country, we are in an affordable housing crisis.
As a county executive, I worked to construct affordable housing units and deliver options for families looking to move to my home county of Westchester, but more action is needed.

The bills I introduced today will deliver relief to young families taking on a mortgage to purchase their first home and to seniors who need to update the bathroom or install a ramp to allow them to age in place.
While the President claims that no one cares about housing, I look forward to moving these commonsense proposals forward with my colleagues to make affordable housing available again.
That is why, this week, I introduced the Home Mortgage Interest Credit Act and the Senior Accessible Housing Tax Credit Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: URGING OMB TO WITHDRAW PROPOSED RULE
statements.title: URGING OMB TO WITHDRAW PROPOSED RULE
sentences: Protect TPS for Haitians and Syrians Mr. Speaker, I rise today 1 week after the Supreme Court decision to end temporary protected status for immigrants from Haiti and Syria.
Supporting Housing Affordability Mr. Speaker, when we talk about the American Dream, most imagine settling down with a good-paying job and a constant roof over their head.
Sadly, that goal continues to grow out of reach for many with rising inflation and the lack of affordable housing.
I saw the pressures of that crisis as Westchester County executive, where I worked to create more than 2,500 affordable housing units.
Mr. Speaker, I urge OMB to withdraw this rulemaking in full.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANNIVERSARY OF OVERTURNING ROE V. WADE
statements.title: ANNIVERSARY OF OVERTURNING ROE V. WADE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today, 4 years after the overturning of Roe v. Wade, to bring to light the devastating impact that the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision has had on our country.
Since Dobbs, government interference in what should be a decision between doctor and patient has led physicians to hesitate, delaying patients from receiving the care they require.
In the wake of Dobbs, laws have caused women to experience unnecessary complications sometimes leading to their death.
On this anniversary, I urge my colleagues to join me in demanding better for my constituents by acting to protect access to reproductive care.

statements.title: CO-OP CITY BUILDING ASSOCIATION PRESIDENTS

We should be ending a war of choice that triggered skyrocketing gas prices and eliminating unnecessary tariffs that increased the costs of groceries and consumer products.
This morning, the news told us that inflation rose to 4.2 percent, the highest level in 3 years, way more important than the name on The Kennedy Center or building a triumphal arch.

If we will not address America's healthcare situation head-on, then let those of us who are willing to address the situation take action. ____________________

statements.title: WE CARE FOR OUR VETERANS
sentences: In Congress, I am committed to maintaining these benefits for veterans and preventing any action that would require additional hurdles to receive these earned benefits.

One major bill I am supporting is top of mind for veterans: H.R. 1970, Providing Veterans Essential Medications Act, will direct the VA to reimburse State homes for the cost of certain costly medications provided to veterans who receive nursing home care.
We will push back against any cuts by this administration that renege on our commitment to our veterans. ____________________

statements.title: ARMENIAN GENOCIDE REMEMBRANCE DAY

statements.title: SALUTING WHITE PLAINS/GREENBURGH NAACP
sentences: Mr. Speaker, let me recognize the outstanding work of the White Plains/Greenburgh branch of the NAACP, led by the energetic Janice Griffith, and powered by women and men in these two communities who have stood up for diversity, equity, and inclusion at a time when these policies are under assault and elimination by this Federal administration.

Standing up for affordable housing, better healthcare, educational resources, and economic growth for Black Americans, the youth, our seniors, and for all of those who are in need, the White Plains/Greenburgh branch of the NAACP has celebrated our past and has pointed us forward to the future.

sentences: The Y was established in 1899 and became the owner of the current site on Weyman Avenue in 2006, assisted by legislation that I sponsored as a member of the New York State Assembly, and over the last 20 years, it has expanded its program for close to 5,000 members with healthy living programs, aquatics programs, and childcare services.

The renovated pool and gymnasium are constantly in use, and the classes that are offered feature after-school programs and universal pre-K programs to assist those with chronic disease, Zumba, Tai chi, yoga, balance, strength and conditioning, and so many more programs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENHANCED IRAN SANCTIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: ENHANCED IRAN SANCTIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, no one in this Chamber should be under any illusions about the nature of the Iranian regime.

For decades, Iran has funded terrorist proxies, threatened our partners and allies, supplied training and arms that killed and maimed dozens of American forces in Iraq, and pursued weapons capabilities that destabilize the Middle East and endanger global security.

The purpose was straightforward: to tighten enforcement against Iran's oil trade and target the global financial networks that allow Tehran to continue selling its petroleum despite existing sanctions.
This legislation expands secondary sanctions authorities to target foreign companies that knowingly purchase, transport, refine, insure, or finance Iranian oil and petroleum products.
That includes shipping companies, port operators, insurance providers, and other logistical actors that help move Iranian crude around the world.

Crucially, it focuses attention on the network of foreign refineries and intermediaries, particularly in China, that have become the primary buyers of sanctioned Iranian oil, giving the executive branch clearer authority to penalize those actors and disrupt that trade.
Last year, President Trump pardoned the founder of Binance, who pleaded guilty to a sanctions evasions crime pertaining to Iran in 2023.

The administration also failed to meaningfully disrupt the Iran-China energy trade or marshal the sustained diplomatic effort required to build international pressure against Tehran's illicit oil exports.
As a result, Iran continued generating billions in energy revenue while the administration's policy drifted.
The United States started a war with Iran that Congress did not authorize and the American people overwhelmingly think makes us less safe.
Consider the trade-off: The money Trump has already spent on this war could have paid for a full year of ACA premium tax credit extensions for Americans here at home.

In a ham-handed attempt to fix a problem of its own making, the Trump administration has suspended sanctions against Russian oil used to finance Putin's war machine, while at the same time it dawdles on a peace solution in Ukraine.
However, the question of Iran will remain, as will its threats of retaliation and destabilization.
Strong enforcement of these sanctions can also ensure that Iran cannot, once again, finance stabilizing activities across the region through oil revenues flowing into Tehran.
At the same time, the future of Iran is highly uncertain.
However, our responsibility is to ensure that the Iranian regime does not have the resources to rebuild the machinery of repression at home or violence abroad.
Mr. Speaker, this bill will be critical for closing loopholes in our existing sanctions infrastructure against Iran, strengthening the President's authorities to limit Tehran's oil trade.
Last year, after an air attack, President Trump announced that we had obliterated Iran's nuclear capacity, but here we are again.

Trump's war of choice with Iran this year has made this bill even more necessary because while the President may want to move on from this war he started at some point in time, war is a two-way street.

Just because he may want to claim victory, as he already has, and even though Iran's capabilities will be reduced, Iran may very well pose an even greater threat now that diplomacy has been taken off the table by this President.

To limit the long-term threat posed by Iran, it is critical that we further limit Tehran's ability to circumvent existing sanctions, tighten the screws on its ability to sell oil, and ensure that it does not gain access to the resources it needs to reconstitute either its nuclear program or its weapons capabilities.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 1422.
Mr. Speaker, I support this legislation.
This bill accomplishes some of that task, and I support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STRENGTHENING GUARDRAILS OF OUR DEMOCRACY
statements.title: STRENGTHENING GUARDRAILS OF OUR DEMOCRACY
sentences: Most recently, he has called for the party to nationalize voting in the United States.

It prohibits: the deployment of our military and Federal officers, if such is likely to disrupt an election; postal confiscation of all mail ballots; and ICE or National Guard from looming at the polls.
That is why, this week, I introduced the POINT Act, because our elections must remain insulated from bad-faith actors who seek to undermine the will of the voters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SALUTING MOUNT VERNON CHAMBER OF COMMERCE
statements.title: SALUTING MOUNT VERNON CHAMBER OF COMMERCE
sentences: The guest speakers cover substantive topics such as access to capital, tax preparation, availability of grant programs, healthcare, personnel issues, tariffs, and much more.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SALUTING SCARSDALE
statements.title: SALUTING SCARSDALE
sentences: Recognizing Village of Dobbs Ferry Mr. Speaker, I want to recognize the outstanding programs provided by the village of Dobbs Ferry that benefit the senior citizens of that community.

Under the able leadership of Abby Connett, in a new center designed for their use, Dobbs Ferry Seniors serves hundreds of seniors annually with a daily nutrition program at lunchtime 5 days a week and activities and programs to engage seniors of all ages.

There are fitness classes daily, from tai chi and dance to chair yoga and mental fitness programs; my favorite, sports trivia; and a variety of board games, mah-jongg, bridge, Rummikub, along with the classic senior staple, bingo.
From the floor of the House of Representatives, we salute the work of the Dobbs Ferry Seniors and the active and energetic members who show that age is more than just a state of mind.

The board has vibrant citizen committees engaged in every aspect of neighborhood life: economic development, housing and zoning, municipal services, parks and recreation, planning and budget, youth services, education, health and human services, and veterans services, with board members and community volunteers engaged together in dialogue and action to serve the overall region.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESSES BEAR BRUNT OF IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT ABUSES
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESSES BEAR BRUNT OF IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT ABUSES
sentences: In the past year, small businesses have faced unrelenting attacks from this administration on everything from tariffs to immigration enforcement.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNFREEZE FUNDS FOR GATEWAY TUNNEL
statements.title: UNFREEZE FUNDS FOR GATEWAY TUNNEL
sentences: For several months, the White House has held these funds captive over misleading claims that the project's contracting policies violate administration policies on diversity, equity, and inclusion.
If construction is delayed, thousands of union construction workers will lose their jobs, and timely completion of this project will be in jeopardy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ALBERTA, CANADA
statements.title: ALBERTA, CANADA
sentences: Yet, those who speculate we should invade and take Greenland by force are operating with Vladimir Putin's ambition to create some illegal and unholy American empire fueled by ideology to force Canada as well into submission to America.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCERNING STATE OF SERVICE AT SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION
statements.title: CONCERNING STATE OF SERVICE AT SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today with great concern about the current state of service in the Social Security Administration.

The Social Security Administration has also created new roadblocks to service in the name of efficiency and fraud prevention, requiring seniors and people with disabilities to complete some transactions in person or online, rather than by phone.

In my district, the Social Security Administration closed the White Plains hearing office, forcing constituents in Westchester to travel farther distances at a greater expense to receive in-person service.
I implore this body to hold the Social Security Administration accountable and ensure that our constituents receive good, convenient, quality service.
We will be held accountable by the voters if we fail this task. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GREENLAND
statements.title: GREENLAND
sentences: Vladimir Putin's Russia launched war to take over Ukraine.
Denmark, a NATO ally, owns Greenland legally.

Any U.S. military action against Greenland breaks the NATO rule and puts us at odds with our allies, allies that in the post-World War II era have helped us restrain Russian aggression for nearly a century.
They lost 43 men there simply because they honored their NATO commitment and stood by their friend, the United States of America.

Perhaps this President hates NATO so much that he has rallied against elements of it before, and in that he supports the wishes of Vladimir Putin that sees NATO as an impediment to his empire building, the desire for retaking Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania, and Ukraine.
We will regret such a decision every day that we live thereafter.

statements.title: SALUTING THE DANNY FUND

statements.title: COMMEMORATING JANUARY 6, 2021

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENDING PREMIUM TAX CREDITS
statements.title: EXTENDING PREMIUM TAX CREDITS

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRESIDENT TRUMP'S TARIFF POLICIES
statements.title: PRESIDENT TRUMP'S TARIFF POLICIES
sentences: Madam Speaker, any day now, the Supreme Court will issue a ruling on whether the President can impose tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.
President Trump's tariff policies have hurt America's small businesses, who often cannot absorb the cost of higher duties.

That is why I recently joined 20 of my colleagues in sending a letter to Treasury Secretary Bessent and Homeland Security Secretary Noem urging both Departments to dedicate resources to planning for the Supreme Court's decision.
Proper planning is needed around an information campaign for small businesses on how to navigate the tariff protest process, ensuring that eligible tariff refunds are provided on an expedited basis.
I urge the Trump administration to work quickly to guarantee that small businesses, the lifeline of our economy, are not left behind because of this erratic policy. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICA NEEDS UNITY
statements.title: AMERICA NEEDS UNITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in today's edition of Politico, there is a story about Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman setting up systems on the border between Nassau County and neighboring New York City, ostensibly to protect Nassau residents from the criminal element coming from their city neighbors.
North of New York City, Westchester County and its border communities--Yonkers, Mt.
The Westchester Bee-Line public bus system takes passengers down to Fordham Road in the Bronx and back.
State senators Jamaal Bailey and Nathalia Fernandez join me in representing both sides of the city/county border between the Bronx, New York City, and Westchester County.

The brave men and women of the NYPD in the 45th and the 47th precincts work together cooperatively with police from Westchester County and its cities to deter and prevent crime and apprehend criminals when crimes do occur.
We don't need Big Brother intrusive facial recognition checkpoints.
Vernon in Westchester County a half a block from the border with the Bronx.
What we do on the Westchester/Bronx border and at any border anywhere is work together, and that is the prototype for the America that surely needs unity.

Think about how much we are going to need that unity, all Americans working together, when we face the next existential threat to our freedom and democracy, as we did with Nazi Germany and militarized Japan.
In the Bronx and Westchester, we will be ready.
We encourage the Bruce Blakemans of the world to stop pandering and start building the cooperation we will need in the days to come. ____________________

statements.title: LETTER TO SECRETARY NOEM AND SECRETARY RUBIO
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I recently wrote a letter to Secretary Noem and Secretary Rubio, which I will share with my colleagues. ``I write today to express my grave concern over the administration's apparent misuse of obscure provisions in our Nation's immigration laws to deport or detain indefinitely individuals without due process.

Independent of whether a noncitizen is guilty of what they are being accused, I fear these actions are setting a bad precedent that undermine the American justice system, runs contrary to the letter and the spirit of the U.S. law, and pose a risk to American citizens at home and abroad. ``The Fifth Amendment provides that all persons in the United States are entitled to due process of law, including, at minimum, notice, an opportunity to be heard, and a decision by a neutral decisionmaker.

These provisions now have novelly been used during peacetime as grounds to send Department of Homeland Security agents to the homes of individuals with varied alien status, including permanent residents and asylum seekers, arrest them, and either detain them indefinitely or forcibly deport them.

The actions taken by the administration to arrest, detain, or deport without lawful due process sets a dangerous precedent for us all, even those who one day may count themselves among former holders of high office.

Given the centuries-old protections granted by our Constitution, I urge the administration to rethink its actions in order to preserve the letter and the spirit of our American laws.'' ____________________
